claimBoundary: Importable structural model demonstrations; not deployed applications or empirical case evidence

cases.name: MemberLedger
cases.demo: Inspect the Member aggregate, role-specific commands, version conflict policy and attributable MemberChange history.

cases.name: ParcelDesk
cases.demo: Follow OrderAccepted through the dispatch queue, worker, simulator adapter and OrderDispatched; inspect DLQ and cancellation/return policies.

cases.name: RoomSlot
cases.demo: Inspect the slot consistency boundary and exact confirm/expiry cutoff, then follow the expiry schedule to its task.

cases.name: GrantDesk
cases.demo: Show the CIM human review task, assignment/decision contracts, evidence storage and overdue schedule. PIM/PSM use persisted commands for human completion.

cases.name: CampusSignal
cases.demo: Show the topic with two independently buffered subscribers and a delivery simulator; contrast feed success with delivery retry.

cases.name: IntakeCheck
cases.demo: Follow the versioned object upload notification into ValidateCsv and inspect metadata, authorized result retrieval and immutable input identity.

cases.name: RenewalRun
cases.demo: Inspect the 02:00 UTC schedule, immutable snapshot, run/checkpoint data and blocked-period/duplicate-effect policies.

cases.name: StockBridge
cases.demo: Compare source/destination contract fields, queue/adapter references and source-version ordering. Both external endpoints are local simulators.

cases.name: FacilityWatch
cases.demo: Follow ingestion through the queue and sustained-threshold worker, inspect sequencing/evidence policy, then the separate staleness schedule.

cases.name: QueueView
cases.demo: Inspect READ_MODEL schemas, versioned projection and queue/status access pattern; trace rebuild/cutover and count consistency.

cases.name: WorkspaceFlow
cases.demo: Follow the function-backed sequential workflow, ALLOW/READY choices, failure defaults, five-second wait and concrete ASL states.

cases.name: AccessRules
cases.demo: Inspect the ordered FIRST-match decision table and explicit default, immutable policy-version binding and evaluator function. Rule metadata does not execute itself.

cases.name: TeamDesk
cases.demo: Inspect explicit organization ownership, two-tenant composite identity/key design and role-specific operations; compare health-only operator access.

cases.name: EvidenceRoom
cases.demo: Inspect independent review, version/hash provenance, holds and serialized disposition policy, then the private bucket and scheduled deletion task.

cases.name: ExportQueue
cases.demo: Follow durable acceptance into queue/DLQ, bounded worker and private result store; inspect cancellation/success race and partial-batch configuration.

cases.name: ColdChain Sentinel
cases.demo: Show the analytical scenario's ingestion, detection, alert fan-out, acknowledgement/escalation and retained evidence. Thresholds/connectivity are review decisions, not asserted domain facts.
